description: Overwrite a sequence with a project item (clip or sequence) at a time: whatever is there on the targeted tracks is replaced. A track index past the last track adds a track. sourceIn and sourceOut place only that range (for example words found in export_transcript, as Text-Based Editing does)

audioTrackIndex.description: Audio track for the audio, 0 = A1. Default 0

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

sourceIn.description: Place only part of the clip: set its source in point first, seconds into the media (give with sourceOut). The item keeps these in and out points, as when they are marked in the Source Monitor

sourceOut.description: Source out point, seconds into the media (give with sourceIn)

videoTrackIndex.description: Video track for the video, 0 = V1. Default 0

name: overwrite_clip
title: Overwrite Clip
